name: QR_Rule_05: Unauthorized RDP Logon
description: Detects successful or failed Remote Desktop logons by users who are not present in the Authorized RDP Users reference set.
gpo_policy: RDP access must be restricted to approved administrators and monitored through a maintained reference set.
expression: SELECT username, sourceip, "LogonType", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4624','4625') AND "LogonType" = '10' AND NOT REFERENCESETCONTAINS('Authorized RDP Users', username) LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Create and maintain an Authorized RDP Users reference set. Test: Event ID is 4624 or 4625, LogonType equals 10, and Username is not contained in the reference set. Response: Dispatch New Event and create an Offense indexed by Username.
